notes.title: Hotfix: The Pirate Ship Revenge
notes.notes: Provide a hotfix for the Pirate Ship Revenge (last level of the pirate island). There was a very small crack between the top of the stairs and the top deck that some crab/shrimp could fall through. Applied a generous coating of tar and pitch to the area to seal the gap.

notes.title: July 16 patch
notes.notes:
* Reduce camera snapping when building a lot of towers which can be visually disruptive
* Gameplay balancing on some pirate ship levels as they are harder than they should be for the earlier levels.
* Tiger Prawns reduced HP
* Lionfish cooldown made about 10% faster so there's a more distinctive difference between the lionfish and Longnose butterfly
* A couple bug fixes regarding controllers
* Background blue changes is easier on the eyes when playing on a large screen

notes.title: June 25, 2025 update
notes.notes:
* Initial addition of Russian Language
* Added GDPR compliance notification that was missed before
* Fix for icons if controller mappings change. Prior build needed to reload, this is now immediate
* Some additional localization tweaks if a particular language did not fit in a button or other UI overlap. Do let us know if you see additional localization weirdness.
